status: frozen after V8 divergence audit, cost-label build, tests, and one-step memory smoke
scientific_role: diagnostic probe on already consumed development300; not a confirmation or reportable heldout result
hypothesis: V8 retains the correct local action in the candidate set but discards exact downstream severity; a cost-weighted action-ranking head will improve end-to-end trajectories without changing the language-model representation.

cost.token_component: action future cumulative-token difference from the exact best action, divided by active-anchor count times maximum lattice tokens
cost.guarantee: one lost reachable anchor dominates the full token-cost range
cost.loss: mean over states of cost-weighted softplus(action_logit - logsumexp(zero-cost logits))

initialization.sequential_head: all components trainable from selected V8 initialization

data.reason_no_augmentation: isolate exact-cost supervision before adding the separately observed coverage change

evaluation.decoder_selection: lexicographic fidelity-0.90 successes, complete trajectories, negative regret

decision.GO_DESIGN_FORMAL_V9: best diagnostic decoder has fidelity-0.90 >=282/300, complete trajectories >=0.90, and regret <=0.03
decision.INCONCLUSIVE_NO_FORMAL_RUN: best fidelity-0.90 result is 279-281/300 or another gate fails
